name: fatestone-of-heaven-enter-destroy-item-fires-diaochan-trigger
notes: Fatestone of Heaven (al6pqkmgmz): "On Enter: Destroy target non-champion object with memory cost 1 or less, or reserve cost 5 or less." The existing fatestone-of-heaven-enter-destroy-cheap-object fixture only exercises the ALLY branch of customDQHandlers["FatestoneOfHeavenDestroy"] (Custom/CardLogic.php), which already called AllyDestroyed() correctly. Its non-ALLY/TOKEN branch instead did a raw OnLeaveField()+MZMove()-to-graveyard, silently skipping every "whenever a permanent is destroyed" trigger -- the same bypass bug already fixed for other cards' destroy effects via GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php (see expel-the-departed-destroy-phantasia-draw, shatter-the-brittle-destroy-draw-memory, and disenchant-destroy-fires-diaochan-trigger for the identical pattern on other cards). FatestoneOfHeavenDestroy is a hand-authored $customDQHandlers entry directly in Custom/CardLogic.php (not a generated GeneratedMacroCode.php dispatch-table entry), so the fix was made in place there instead of via a GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php override: the branch now unconditionally calls AllyDestroyed($player, $lastDecision) regardless of target type. AllyDestroyed()/DoAllyDestroyed() (GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GameLogic.php) was confirmed to be a fully generic 'object destroyed' dispatcher, not ally-specific despite the name -- it already handles ITEM/WEAPON destroys for other cards (Ghastly Corrosion, Reduce to Ash, Crumbling Reign, Rapid Combustion, Shatter the Brittle all route items/weapons through it via GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php). Diao Chan, Idyll Corsage (d7l6i5thdy) is seeded onto the destroyer's own field (myField-1, a secondary non-champion-slot entry, same 'canary' technique as disenchant-destroy-fires-diaochan-trigger) as a canary: her "whenever a non-token object an opponent controls is destroyed, you may banish it; if you do, that opponent summons a Flowerbud token" ability only fires through DoAllyDestroyed()'s trigger dispatch. Fatestone of Heaven is LUXEM, so the champion's Subcards are patched with Zander, Blinding Steel's lineage for element access, exactly as in the ALLY fixture. Craggy Fatestone (h8n1520m2d, ITEM, reserve cost 4 <= 5) is seeded onto the opponent's field as the destroy target; the MZCHOOSE offers both it and Fatestone of Heaven itself (reserve cost 3, also self-eligible), and the opponent's Craggy Fatestone is chosen. Verified live: after choosing the target and answering Diao Chan's YESNO with YES, the Craggy Fatestone ends up in the opponent's banish zone (not graveyard) and the opponent's field gains a Flowerbud token (yn78t73w1p) -- both effects are only reachable through AllyDestroyed()'s trigger dispatch, so they directly distinguish the fix from the old raw-move bypass (which would leave the card in the graveyard and never queue Diao Chan's YESNO decision at all, causing the fixture's final 'YES' action to fail outright against a decision that was never queued). Break/restore verified: temporarily reverting customDQHandlers["FatestoneOfHeavenDestroy"]'s non-ALLY branch back to the raw OnLeaveField()+MZMove() bypass makes this fixture fail (action 5's 'YES' input has no matching YESNO decision to answer, since Diao Chan's trigger never fires), and restoring the AllyDestroyed() call makes it pass again. Full suite re-run at 742/742 after the fix (baseline 741/741 unchanged otherwise).

rulesClauses: On Enter: Destroy target non-champion object with memory cost 1 or less, or reserve cost 5 or less.
Diao Chan, Idyll Corsage: whenever a non-token object an opponent controls is destroyed, you may banish it. If you do, that opponent summons a Flowerbud token.
